title: [WIP] Fix action step error in CI workflow
body:
## Fix TypeScript Build Errors in examples/basic

### Problem
The `examples/basic` package has TypeScript compilation errors due to:
1. Incorrect imports from `@objectstack/spec` (namespace structure not followed)
2. Type mismatches in example code
3. Missing/incorrect property names in type definitions

### Plan
- [x] Investigate CI build failure logs
- [x] Identify root cause: imports need to use namespaced structure
- [x] Update all example files to use correct namespace imports
  - [x] ai-rag-example.ts - Use AI.* namespace
  - [x] api-discovery-example.ts - Use API.* namespace
  - [x] auth-permission-example.ts - Use Auth.* and Permission.* namespace
  - [x] automation-example.ts - Use Automation.* namespace
  - [x] stack-definition-example.ts - Fix type mismatches
- [x] Fix remaining type errors in examples
  - [x] ai-rag-example.ts - Add missing required properties
  - [x] auth-permission-example.ts - Fix RLS and Territory types
  - [x] automation-example.ts - Fix workflow criteria and action types
  - [x] stack-definition-example.ts - Fix Object, Dashboard, Workflow types
- [x] Build and verify all fixes locally
- [x] Ensure CI passes

### Changes Made

#### ai-rag-example.ts
- ✅ Updated imports to use `AI` namespace
- ✅ Added missing vector store properties (`batchSize`, `connectionPoolSize`, `timeout`)
- ✅ Added missing RAG query request properties (`includeMetadata`, `includeSources`)
- ✅ Fixed agent knowledge configuration (changed from pipeline to indexes/topics)
- ✅ Fixed tool types (added required `type` field)

#### api-discovery-example.ts
- ✅ Updated imports to use `API` namespace

#### auth-permission-example.ts
- ✅ Updated imports to use `Auth` and `Permission` namespaces
- ✅ Added missing `priority` field to RLS policies
- ✅ Fixed Territory schema (removed invalid fields, added required fields)
- ✅ Fixed User type usage (added roles as extended property)

#### automation-example.ts
- ✅ Updated imports to use `Automation` namespace
- ✅ Changed all `criteria` from objects to formula strings
- ✅ Changed all action types from camelCase to snake_case
- ✅ Fixed workflow rule structure and properties
- ✅ Fixed approval process structure
- ✅ Removed invalid Flow and ETLPipeline examples

#### stack-definition-example.ts
- ✅ Added required `id` and `type` fields to manifest
- ✅ Changed `fields` from arrays to Record (object) format
- ✅ Fixed reference fields (string instead of object)
- ✅ Fixed View schema structure
- ✅ Fixed Dashboard widgets
- ✅ Fixed workflow actions
- ✅ Fixed agent configuration

### Verification
✅ All examples now compile successfully with TypeScript
✅ Full project build passes
